meta.title: 存几个简单出片的生命力拍照姿势快来学
meta.title_en: Save These Simple, Alive Photo Poses — Come Learn!

scenes.context: 第一招：手臂大幅张开。核心是敢做大，动作越大越有张力。语域：拍照教学，张力动作。
sentences: spread your arms wide（手臂张开）
The key is daring to go big.
paraphrase: 张开 → spread wide / open up
scenes.speak: First: spread your arms wide. The key is daring to go big. Bigger moves mean more tension.

scenes.context: 第二招：跳跃抓拍。用连拍模式，选表情最自然的一张。语域：拍照教学，连拍技巧。
sentences: Pick the shot with the most natural expression.
paraphrase: 连拍模式 → burst mode / continuous shooting
选一张 → pick the shot / choose one frame
pick the shot · choose one frame
scenes.speak: Second: jump and shoot candid. Turn on burst mode. Pick the shot with the most natural expression.

scenes.context: 第三招：侧身回眸。有方向感和互动感，比正面直对镜头更自然。语域：拍照教学，互动姿态。
sentences: Third: glance back from the side.
direction and interaction（方向感与互动）
比正面直对镜头更自然。
More natural than facing the camera head-on.
paraphrase: 回眸 → glance back / look over the shoulder
glance back · look over the shoulder
互动感 → interaction / a sense of connection
scenes.speak: Third: glance back from the side. It brings direction and interaction. More natural than facing the camera head-on.

scenes.context: 自然收尾：最有生命力的照片往往是以为拍完了的那张。趁放松按下快门。语域：拍照教学，收尾抓拍。
sentences: 收尾：最有生命力的那张。
The most alive shot comes at the end.
the most alive shot（最有生命力）
往往是以为拍完了的那张。
It's often the one you thought was over.
paraphrase: 生命力 → alive / full of life
以为拍完了 → thought it was over / caught off guard
thought it was over · caught off guard
scenes.speak: The most alive shot comes at the end. It's often the one you thought was over. Shoot while everyone is relaxed.

practice: The most alive shot comes at the end.
pitfalls: 「大幅张开」用 spread wide，突出幅度。
「连拍」用 burst mode，选最自然一张。
「回眸」是 glance back / look over the shoulder。
「趁放松」用 while relaxed / off guard。
shifts: 说打开拍照只会 open camera
用 burst mode（连拍）、snap candid（抓拍）、pick the shot（选片）
用 spread arms wide（张开手臂）、glance back（回眸）、daring to go big（敢做大）
用 full of life（生命力）、more tension（张力）、natural expression（自然表情）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：手臂大幅张开、敢做大、张力、连拍模式、表情最自然、侧身回眸、方向感互动感、正面直对镜头、以为拍完了的那张等。
